title: What do you usually do?
goal_hi: Apna morning routine aur office routine simple present me batana.

forms.positive: I usually check my email at nine.
forms.negative: I don't usually check email at night.
forms.question: What do you usually do in the morning?

pattern.note_hi: Usually + verb; time ke pehle at.

examples.en: I usually check my email at nine.
examples.hi: Main aam taur par nau baje email check karta hoon.

examples.en: I usually start work at ten.
examples.hi: Main aam taur par das baje kaam shuru karta hoon.

examples.en: She usually takes the metro to the office.
examples.hi: Woh aam taur par office metro se jaati hai.

examples.en: I usually have breakfast at eight.
examples.hi: Main aam taur par aath baje nashta karta hoon.

examples.en: We usually have a standup at ten thirty.
examples.hi: Hum aam taur par das baje tees minute par standup karte hain.

words.example_en: I have a simple morning routine.

words.example_hi: Mera safar chalees minute leta hai.

words.example_en: I set an alarm for seven.
words.example_hi: Main saat baje ka alarm lagata hoon.
Main aath baje nashta karta hoon.

dialogue.title: Monday morning chat
dialogue.context_hi: Office kitchen, Monday 9:30. Colleague Riya se short morning chat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hi: Morning! Aaj tum jaldi aa gaye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Morning! Yeah, I usually start at nine. What about you?
lines.hi: Morning! Haan, main aam taur par nau baje shuru karta hoon. Tum?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I usually start at ten, but I have a client call today.
lines.hi: Main aam taur par das baje shuru karti hoon, par aaj client call hai.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Busy day, then. Do you want a coffee?
lines.hi: Toh busy din hai. Coffee chahiye?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure, thanks. I usually have one before my first call.
lines.hi: Haan, thanks. Main aam taur par pehli call se pehle ek leti hoon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Same here. I usually check my email with coffee.
lines.hi: Mere saath bhi wahi. Main aam taur par coffee ke saath email check karta hoon.

sound_focus.tip_hi: Third person -s clear bolo: start-s, check-s, take-s. 's' ko chhodo mat.

scenario.setting_hi: Office kitchen me colleague Riya se subah ki baat.

turns.prompt_en: Morning! You're here early. What time do you usually start?
turns.hint_hi: Batao ki aap aam taur par nau baje shuru karte ho.

turns.prompt_en: Do you check email before the standup?
turns.hint_hi: Haan, coffee ke saath email check karte ho.
turns.model_en: Yes, I usually check my email with coffee.

turns.prompt_en: What about your commute? Do you take the metro?
turns.hint_hi: Nahi, bike se aate ho aur lagbhag bees minute lagte hain.
turns.model_en: I usually commute by bike. It takes about twenty minutes.

turns.prompt_en: What do you do on a busy morning?
turns.hint_hi: Alarm saat baje, breakfast, phir office.
turns.model_en: My alarm rings at seven. I have breakfast and leave for the office.

quiz.answer: I usually start work at ten.
